paragraphs.text:
The beast-men advance down the slopes, wary. They are fully 
upright,  human-like  despite  their  muscular  bulk  and  apish 
crests. When they get close, you start to cough. Their stench 
is overwhelming.

Your  years  of  training  suggest  techniques  to  pacify  and 
mollify the sasquatches.

Make an Anthropology roll: if you succeed, go to 627; if you fail, 
go to 629.
